reasons: A builds four of its five slogans on the same doubtful idiom «бить батоны», and «мягче, чем ваши оправдания» has no wordplay in it at all. B draws on several sources of wordplay, and «корочка» as both crust and diploma is a real Russian pun, though «тесто» meaning money is an English calque and «крутой» is weak. Overall B is more varied and funnier in Russian.

A: Presents «бить батоны» as an established idiom meaning to idle; the standard idiom is «бить баклуши».
B: Presents «бить батоны» as an established idiom meaning to idle; the standard idiom is «бить баклуши».
Claims «тесто» is Russian slang for money; this is an English calque of 'dough', not common Russian slang.
